eventDefs.name: Air leak
eventDefs.realBasis: Habitat maintenance: small leaks are a real worry on the space station.

eventDefs.name: Dusty panels
eventDefs.realBasis: Mars dust storms, like the global storm of 2018, cover solar panels.

eventDefs.name: Sick crops
eventDefs.realBasis: Growing food in space is hard; the CSA food-in-space toolkit explains why.

eventDefs.name: Recycler jam
eventDefs.realBasis: The space station recycles most of its water, and the machines need repairs.

eventDefs.name: Supply drop spotted
eventDefs.hint: Spare parts wait outside for 2 sols
eventDefs.realBasis: Real missions plan cargo resupply carefully.

eventDefs.name: Crew fatigue
eventDefs.hint: Tired crew lose health each night
eventDefs.realBasis: NASA studies show rest matters for astronaut health.

modules.name: Storm Shelter
modules.plus: Each room touching it blocks 1 more storm damage (max 3)
modules.why: Thick walls and neighbours stop particles.

modules.name: Extra solar panel
modules.minus: More panels to clean: dusty panels happen more often
modules.why: Dust on panels cut power for NASA's solar rovers.

modules.name: Regolith shield wall
modules.plus: Halves radiation for the room it touches
modules.minus: Needs lots of trips outside (more dose now)
modules.why: Soil is a cheap, heavy radiation shield.

modules.name: Oxygen maker
modules.why: Perseverance's MOXIE made oxygen from the Mars air.

modules.name: Greenhouse
modules.plus: +7 life support every sol (starts 2 sols after building)
modules.minus: Uses 5 power every sol; crops can get sick
modules.why: Plants need light, water and warmth.

modules.name: Big battery
modules.plus: Covers up to 20 power on a dark night
modules.minus: Uses parts you need for other machines
modules.why: Storage is how solar bases get through storms.

modules.name: Water recycler
modules.minus: It jams sometimes and needs repairs
modules.why: The space station recycles most of its water.

modules.name: Gym corner
modules.plus: +4 health on nights after you exercise
modules.minus: Costs an hour each sol to use
modules.why: Low gravity weakens bones and muscles (NASA OSDR studies).

modules.name: Comms dish
modules.plus: The Radio also warns about tomorrow night
modules.why: Bigger antennas hear better, but light speed doesn't change.

modules.name: Landing pad
modules.plus: The next crew can land safely (best endings)
modules.minus: A big build right before the finale
modules.why: Pads stop rocket engines blasting dust and rocks.

spots.name: Sand dunes
spots.blurb: Close by. Loose sand and soil for shield walls and the landing pad.

spots.name: Water-rich soil
spots.blurb: Farther out. Scoop soil and bake the water out of it. Leftover cargo crates sometimes turn up.

spots.name: Layered rocks
spots.blurb: Rock laid down in an ancient lake, like the rock Curiosity drills. Samples unlock blueprints.

spots.name: Supply drop
spots.blurb: A cargo pod landed nearby. Grab the spare parts before they're lost.

sites.name: Gale crater
sites.blurb: Curiosity's home. Radiation numbers come from its real instrument here.

sites.name: Jezero crater
sites.blurb: Perseverance's home, an old lake bed. Rockier ground.

traits.name: Green thumb
traits.text: The greenhouse makes 2 more life support

traits.name: Fast walker
traits.text: Walking around the base takes half the time

traits.name: Rock hound
traits.text: Science trips can find a bonus sample

traits.name: Handy
traits.text: Every hour of building counts a bit extra

traits.name: Trail runner
traits.text: Long trips outside take 30 minutes less
